Kunal Pandey | kunal.pandey588@example.com | +91 9213691887
Chennai

Professional Summary
Experienced business development and account management professional with a background in technology-enabled sales and client delivery. Strong track record generating enterprise opportunities, managing key accounts, and driving contract negotiations using CRM platforms and sales process tools.

Technical Skills
B2B Sales, Salesforce, CRM, Negotiation, Key Account Management, Linux, Agile, Jira

Work Experience

Senior Business Development Manager, Cognizant (Nov 2023 - Present)
- Generated pipeline of enterprise B2B Sales opportunities within target verticals, qualifying leads through Salesforce and advancing 12 strategic deals to proposal stage.
- Managed CRM hygiene in Salesforce, ensuring accurate forecasting and reducing deal slippage by improving data completeness and stage definitions.
- Led commercial Negotiation for multi-year transformations, securing contracts with average ACV improvements and coordinating with delivery and legal teams.
- Collaborated with Agile delivery leads and used Jira for handoff, ensuring smooth transition from sales to implementation for new client engagements.

Account Executive, Paystack India (Sep 2017 - Oct 2023)
- Owned Key Account Management for a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise clients, increasing wallet share through cross-sell and upsell initiatives tracked in CRM.
- Drove complex Negotiation cycles for pricing and SLAs, closing deals that expanded recurring revenue and strengthened long-term retention.
- Maintained CRM records to improve renewal forecasting accuracy and enable account plans that targeted growth opportunities.
- Coordinated internally with technical teams, leveraged Linux-based demo environments and Jira to prioritize client feature requests and delivery timelines.

Education
B.Tech, Computer Science, VIT Vellore
